Training terms
Rep
One complete repetition of an exercise.
Set
A group of reps performed together before resting.
Warm-up set
A lighter set to prepare for the working sets.
Working set
A set at your working weight.
Working weight
The load you use for your main sets. Warm-up percentages use this load.
Rest
Time between sets before starting the next one.
Compound exercise
A movement that uses multiple joints, such as a squat.
Isolation exercise
A movement that emphasizes one muscle group, such as a leg extension.
